title: RBL Bajaj Finserv Platinum Edge Supercard (Freedom) credit card

cardOverview.overviewText: A co-branded Bajaj Finserv Platinum Edge Supercard from RBL offering EMI conversion, cashback on spends, and milestone vouchers, tailored for financing convenience.

benefitRows.name: BookMyShow
benefitRows.offer: Via BookMyShow, avail B1G1 free.|Avail 1 free ticket in a Single Transaction upto ₹200 per month.
benefitRows.howToAvail: All Cardmembers can avail the offer by applying under the offers/discounts section on the BookMyShow checkout page. Visit www.rblbank.com for details. Cardmember will need to add their Card details and expiry date for availing the offer. This offer cannot be clubbed with any other offer.
